message: FINAL_DRAFT_APPROVED. Ten final_draft.md files, 20,871 words. Validation sweep: forbidden patterns 0 matches across 20 patterns; word counts 10/10 on target; NPC registry 0 mismatches (0 Star trait, 0 Gloom clock, 0 Traits above +2); heading links 125 headings / 125 unique ids / 34 internal links / 0 broken / 0 self-links, after renaming chapter_10's three beat subheads to clear a compiled-anchor collision with chapter_08; diff verification 10/10 differ from draft_02; banned terms 0 violations. Gate final_draft PASSED.

ART_DIRECTION_COMPLETE in prompt-manifest mode. 33 prompts authored to development/art_prompts.md (1 cover + 10 chapter openers + 11 NPC portraits + 11 content illustrations at 1 per 2,000 words), all 33 registered in art_manifest.json with reserved content/art/ paths. Mode was forced: the active generator ideogram-v4 has a comfyui backend and /art-direction's probe is a1111-only. Cover crossed modes as the skill allows and was generated algorithmically ('Refraction', a p5.js sketch in development/cover_sketch/, seed 20260826, 1600x2400) so /compile has a real cover; it is a standalone piece, not a render of the reserved cover prompt.

Third review round resolved. Six rules/continuity defects fixed: the Chord's key restated as one note per Star (three- and four-Star teams could not sound five); Formation restricted to Stars who have both not yet acted, closing a double-action hole; Chapter 8's Miss list restructured so the clock tick or Shine loss is mandatory and the named Gloom move is the fiction carrying it, not an alternative to it; the three-player lineup corrected from Wren/Priya/Danny to Wren/Priya/Marisol, which is the trio that actually has the +2 coverage the text claims; and Chapter 10's Chorus no longer crosses into the Spectrum before the Bridge, since refracting and morphing are the same act. Three compile-phase verification steps in the plan were also corrected before use.

Fourth review round resolved. The Formation restriction was propagated into references/prism/00-core-rules.md, which round three had left contradicting the corrected Chapter 4. Backing eligibility no longer resets each Number: honesty, once had, persists, which is what canon says and what the pregen paragraph assumes. The character sheet gained the two bracketed morphed-Shine boxes and its Sparkle track was corrected to the real starting maximum of 3, as was Chapter 10's Quick Reference. initialize_project now seeds one gate vocabulary so a finished project reports 7/7 rather than 7/12, and pass_quality_gate resolves the next gate inside the caller's vocabulary instead of across both.

ART_COMPLETE. All 33 images present in content/art/, generated locally on Ideogram 4 through ComfyUI at no per-image cost. Four rendering passes: 18 usable from the first, then re-cuts for refusals and quality. Gender parity fixed — canon is Wren, Priya and Marisol she/her and Toby and Danny he/him, and the first pass had rendered every figure male because the captions asked for 'ungendered presentation'. Style pushed harder toward Lisa Frank. Cover remains the algorithmic 'Refraction'.

COMPILATION_READY. 21,529 words compiled from 10 chapters with 33 images embedded (1 cover, 10 openers, 11 portraits, 11 content illustrations; 22 placed inline). Validation clean: 0 forbidden patterns, 0 broken links, 0 duplicate heading ids, 0 missing images, cover first in every format. Exports: markdown, DOCX, EPUB, PDF, plus a triple-spaced editing PDF. Five pre-existing defects in the export toolchain were fixed to get here.
